title: HCCMultimodalCaseInput
description: Unified input envelope for the HCC multimodal three-line case pipeline. Designed to map 1:1 to existing CLI arguments with minimal code changes.

case_id.description: User-visible case identifier. May equal patient_id for single-patient cases.

patient_id.description: Research pseudonym. Must match DICOM PatientID when DICOM is supplied.

index_date.description: ISO-8601 decision/index date. Defaults to imaging study_date when omitted.

dicom_dir.description: Path to directory containing CT/MR DICOM series.

seg.description: Optional path to DICOM SEG or NIfTI segmentation mask.

phase.description: Optional phase hint: arterial, portal_venous, delayed, unknown.

image_evidence.description: Path to image-tool JSON file, or inline ImageToolEvidence object.

laboratory.description: Laboratory evidence: either a file path or inline content. The parser auto-detects TXT/JSON/CSV from file extension or explicit format.

content.description: Raw laboratory report content. For json/csv, this must be valid JSON/CSV text.

hpi.description: Optional history-of-present-illness evidence: either a file path or inline content.

content.description: Raw HPI text or JSON event array.

llm_response.description: Optional offline LLM rewrite JSON to validate against the deterministic summary.

output_dir.description: Directory for pipeline artifacts. Equivalent to --output.
